wiki.quote: Огонь — хороший слуга, но жестокий хозяин.

entries.name: Anti-Mage
lines: Blink allows Anti-Mage to get on top of Lina and deal damage with his Mana Break.
Counterspell makes Anti-Mage tanky against Lina's heavy magic damage. It can also be used block and reflect Laguna Blade.
Mana Void is very hazardous for Lina, who has a high mana pool and quickly depletes it during fights.

entries.name: Faceless Void
lines: Time Walk will easily backtrack Lina's burst damage (especially Laguna Blade) if not timed correctly.
During Chronosphere, squishy heroes like Lina will be main target of Faceless Void in his ultimate.

entries.name: Ember Spirit
lines: Ember Spirit absorbs quite a large amount of magical damage with its Flame Guard, and in addition dodges the abilities of Dragon Slave and Light Strike Array with its Sleight of Fist.

entries.name: Lifestealer
lines: Rage protects Lifestealer from all of Lina's abilities. However, Lina can paritally counter this if played as Carry, a common role for Lina.
Open Wounds from Aghanim's Shard can severely slow down Lina and allow Lifestealer and his allies to recover themselves by attacking her.

Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Infest can be used to disarm Lina even if she is spell immune, rendering her unable to maximize the effect of her Fiery Soul and force her to use her abilities more often than intended. And Lina's only way to counter this is with Linken's Sphere

entries.name: Nyx Assassin
lines: Mind Flare does tons of damage against Lina because of her high intelligence.
Vendetta can deal heavy damage to Lina while also burning her mana, preventing Lina from casting her abilities.

Spiked Carapace can easily be used to counter Lina's abilities because of their long cast animation, and could probably kill Lina outright if Laguna Blade is reflected. However, Lina can counter this with Eul's Scepter of Divinity, a common item on Lina.

entries.name: Phantom Lancer
lines: Doppelganger can be used to easily dodge Light Strike Array if timed correctly.

While Lina can clear Phantom Lancer's illusions with her abilities, Phantom Lancer can quickly deplete Lina's mana pool with his illusions and deal massive damage from it simultaneously since Phantom Lancer is a natural Diffusal Blade carrier.

entries.name: Puck
lines: Puck can dodge Lina's Dragon Slave and Light Strike Array with his Phase Shift skill, which helps him avoid combining these abilities with Laguna Blade and avoid burst damage from Lina.
Puck forbids Lina to use her abilities with the Waning Rift ability, which will help her teammates survive and even give them the opportunity to kill her.

entries.name: Silencer
lines: Arcane Curse makes it too difficult Lina from using her abilities, preventing her from building up Fiery Soul stacks without causing harm to herself.
Last Word and Global Silence are great against Lina for the same reason, as well as interrupting her combos and preventing her from casting spells.

entries.name: Slark
lines: Dark Pact can be cast during the cast animation of Light Strike Array and dispel its stun.
Pounce allows Slark to close the gap to Lina.
Shadow Dance prevents Lina from killing Slark with her Laguna Blade when his HP gets low.

entries.name: Spectre
lines: Spectral Dagger and Haunt allow Spectre to get close to Lina.
Desolate is very strong against Lina, who's usually a bit isolated in fights because of her high attack and cast range.
Dispersion can mitigate a good portion of Lina's burst damage, allowing Spectre to turn on her afterwards.

entries.name: Storm Spirit
lines: Storm Spirit can quickly close the distance with Lina using Ball Lightning. In addition, Ball Lightning can be used as a way to dodge the abilities of Dragon Slave and Light Strike Array

entries.name: Sven
lines: Sven has a high health pool and is a natural Black King Bar holder and is very hard to kill for Lina.
Sven also has high physical damage, making it easy for him to burst her down.

entries.name: Templar Assassin
lines: Templar Assassin can outmatch Lina on the center line thanks to her own Psi Blades, which is why the advantage of Lina's long-range attacks become turned against her.
Refraction is good defense against Lina's burst damage. But remember that Lina can partially counter this with Dragon Slave's damage over time.

entries.name: Viper
lines: Viper Strike prevents buildup of Fiery Soul stacks.
Corrosive Skin provides magic resistance against Lina's spells. However, Lina can counter this with Silver Edge, a common item on Lina.
Poison Attack and Viper Strike can burn away Lina's small health pool.
Heroes with abilities that can pull Lina out of position can easily bring her to their team mates, like Batrider with Flaming Lasso, Pudge with Meat Hook and Vengeful Spirit with Nether Swap.
Heroes that can close the gap can easily chase Lina down, such as Timbersaw with Timber Chain and Anti-Mage with Blink.
Heroes with spell immunity unless Lina chooses to play Carry role like Lifestealer with Rage and Juggernaut with Blade Fury.
Infused Raindrops can keep it's owner alive against Lina's magic burst damage in the early game.
Black King Bar prevents Lina from using her abilities to kill enemy heroes. And Lina's only way to counter it is by playing Carry role.
Eul's Scepter of Divinity can be used to dodge Lina's abilities. However, an ill-timed use of it can make it's owner an easy target for Light Strike Array.
Blade Mail can be used to reflect Lina's burst damage back to her.
Eternal Shroud, Pipe of Insight Glimmer Cape, and Mage Slayer will greatly weaken Lina's mostly magical damage output.
Linken's Sphere will block Laguna Blade. And Lina's only way to pop it is by using an disable from an item to put it on a cooldown.
Lotus Orb will reflect Laguna Blade back at Lina if she impulsively tries to use it on a hero affected by it.

entries.name: Ancient Apparition
lines: Lina builds Shadow Blade (and upgrades it into a Silver Edge), which makes it hard for Ancient Apparition to land his abilities.
Laguna Blade can kill Ancient Apparition easily due to his low health pool and lack of mobility.

entries.name: Chen
lines: Lina's high damage burst from Dragon Slave, Light Strike Array and Laguna Blade can easily kill Chen's allies or Chen himself before he can use Hand of God.

entries.name: Clinkz
lines: Lina's damage burst can quickly kill Clinkz before he saves them with Skeleton Walk.
Fiery Soul attack speed bonus removes Burning Army easily in all stages of the game.

entries.name: Crystal Maiden
lines: Being a hero with low health and abysmal mobility, Lina can nuke her down easily.
Since Crystal Maiden's Freezing Field is a channeled ability, Lina can use her Light Strike Array to cancel it easily.

entries.name: Dazzle
lines: Laguna Blade can kill Dazzle quickly before he casts Shallow Grave.

entries.name: Enchantress
lines: Enchantress has pitiful health, and cannot tank Lina's heavy magic damage.
Untouchable is decently countered by Fiery Soul, exposing Enchantress's weakness to physical damage due to her low armor.
Lina is decent at clearing creeps and can kill Enchantress' creeps quickly.

entries.name: Huskar
lines: Lina can interrupt Huskar on the center line because of her attack range, she can constantly be at a long distance, punching Huskar with her hand, while Huskar needs a very close distance to use Burning Spear.

entries.name: Meepo
lines: Light Strike Array can catch Meepo and his clones off-guard if he tries to gank Lina with Earthbind & Poof.
Laguna Blade can quickly kill Meepo and his clones before they escape with Poof.

entries.name: Mirana
lines: Moonlight Shadow does little good against Dragon Slave and Light Strike Array.
Lina's damage burst can quickly kill Mirana's teammates before she saves them with Moonlight Shadow.

entries.name: Morphling
lines: Light Strike Array catches Morphling while he jumps in from Waveform and also prevents Morphling from using his abilities.
Laguna Blade can kill Morphling quickly before he shifts into Attribute Shift (Strength Gain).

entries.name: Necrophos
lines: Ghost Shroud is not a good defensive ability against Lina as all of her abilities deal magical damage.
Lina has a very long range of attack, which completely overlaps the range of Death Pulse and Heartstopper Aura.

However, once Necrophos gets Aghanim's Shard, he will gain access to Death Seeker which will allow him to turn into a larger Death Pulse that can be used to close the gap on Lina and kill her if she is not careful.

entries.name: Queen of Pain
lines: Lina has a very long range of attack, which completely overlaps the range of Queen of Pain's abilities and attacks, which is why even a single Shadow Strike roll can become deplorable, since Lina will shoot Queen of Pain from a long distance before and after the Shadow Strike roll. And with the help of the abilities of Light Strike Array and Laguna Blade, Lina can even kill Queen of Pain because of her small health reserve if she is exposed to a blow

entries.name: Phantom Assassin
lines: Laguna Blade is one of the best tools to kill Phantom Assassin before she can do anything in early-to-mid game due to its high magical (pure with Laguna Blade damage is Pure and pierces Spell Immunity talent) burst damage.
Blur offers no protection against Lina's abilities. Likewise, Lina can counter Blur's evasion by buying either Silver Edge or Monkey King Bar.

Lina just has to be careful about Fan of Knives from Aghanim's Shard and Coup de Grace, as Fan of Knives can deal pure damage to Lina and disable Fiery Soul awhile Coup de Grace can deal serious damage to her even if she is spell immune, which may force Lina to buy Ethereal Blade to deal with Phantom Assassin.

entries.name: Pudge
lines: Pudge has low armor and mobility, making him suspectible to her physical attacks (if Lina is the carry).
Because Dismember is a channeled ability, it can be canceled through Light Strike Array within a distance.

entries.name: Shadow Fiend
lines: Lina can outlanes Shadow Fiend on the central line, due to the fact that Lina's attack range exceeds the attack range of Shadow Fiend, which makes it difficult for him to fend off her attacks and approach creeps, thus Lina has more level and gold.

Lina can defeat Shadow Fiend with the combination of her abilities on lane and during teamfights: Light Strike Array, Dragon Slave, Laguna Blade, Shadow Fiend does not have a large pool of health before buying items for extra strength and health like Satanic, which is why Lina's strong magic damage is enough to kill him quickly.

entries.name: Sniper
lines: Lina defeats Sniper on the mid, because she has the same attack range as him, and her Dragon Slave ability deals much more damage to creeps, as well as to Sniper himself, than Shrapnel, which creates uncomfortable conditions for Sniper to farm on the line, which is why Lina either punches Sniper harder than he either pushes a pack of creeps up to the tower and finishes off his creeps under it, preventing Sniper from earning gold and a level.

entries.name: Terrorblade
lines: Laguna Blade is one of the best tools to kill Terrorblade before he can use Sunder due to its high magical damage.
Dragon Slave and Light Strike Array allows Lina to clear Terrorblade's illusions from both, Conjure Image and Manta Style.
Lina commonly buys items that allow her attacks to deal magical damage to Terrorblade that can ignore his high armor, like Gleipnir, Monkey King Bar or Revenant's Brooch.

entries.name: Treant Protector
lines: Light Strike Array and Dragon Slave allows Lina to destroy trees, countering Nature's Guise and Eyes In The Forest.
Lina has many tools to bypass Living Armor's protection.

entries.name: Venomancer
lines: Venomancer has low health, which makes him vulnerable to Lina's heavy magic damage.
Fiery Soul attack speed bonus removes Plague Wards easily in all stages of the game.
Heroes who have low health, armor and mobility are vulnerable to Lina's high magical damage.
Heroes who have channeled abilities can be stunned by Light Strike Array, like Witch Doctor with Death Ward and Bane's Fiend's Grip.
Heroes who rely on armor or evasion to survive can easily be bursted down, like Phantom Assassin, Terrorblade, Underlord, Spirit Breaker.

Heroes with summons and illusions can find themselves easily bested by Lina, like Broodmother, Nature's Prophet, Chen, Terrorblade, Naga Siren, Visage, Wraith King, Lycan, Phantom Lancer, Shadow Shaman.
Even though Eul's Scepter of Divinity can be used to dodge Lina's abilities, an ill-tiemd use of it will set an enemy up for Light Strike Array.
Ghost Scepter and Ethereal Blade are useless against Lina's high magical damage, especially from Laguna Blade.

While Black King Bar can make Lina unable to damage enemy heroes with her abilities, Lina is often played as Carry thanks to the high attack speed provided by Fiery Soul, which allows her to partially counter it's debuff immunity, particularly when Lina buys items for attack speed and attack damage.

entries.name: Shadow Demon
lines: Disruption can set up Light Strike Array. And the illusions from Disruption can benefit from Fiery Soul.

entries.name: Sven
lines: Storm Hammer can ensure a perfect Light Strike Array.
Lina's long range makes her a great support to lane with Sven and harass the enemy.

entries.name: Luna
lines: Though Light Strike Array has small area-of-effect, it can be somewhat of a solid setup for Eclipse.
Lina will greatly benefit from Lunar Blessing as that means she can deal bonus attack damage when she has lots of stacks from Fiery Soul.
Lucent Beam can also be used to put Linken's Sphere on cooldown and allow Lina to freely use Laguna Blade on a hero who tries to protect himself/herself with Linken's Sphere.

entries.name: Naga Siren
lines: Naga Siren's Ensnare helps Lina land a good Light Strike Array on an enemy hero much more easily.
Though Light Strike Array has small area-of-effect, it can be somewhat of a solid follow up with Song of the Siren.
Lina's Dragon Slave and Light Strike Array can clear waves of creeps, summons, and illusions, allowing Naga Siren and her illusions from Mirror Image to destroy towers more easily.

entries.name: Pugna
lines: Decrepify can hugely increase Lina's magic damage output. The slow can act as a setup for Light Strike Array.

entries.name: Huskar
lines: Lina's Dragon Slave and Huskar's Burning Spears can deal serious damage over time to enemy heroes, which allows Lina and Huskar to pressure enemy heroes on lane.

Huskar's Life Break can severely slow down an enemy hero, making it a good setup for Light Strike Array, especially when Life Break is upgraded with Aghanim's Scepter, which will allow it to force targeted enemy hero to attack Huskar.

entries.name: Bane
lines: Nightmare (and later Fiend's Grip) is a perfect set up for Light Strike Array.

entries.name: Grimstroke
lines: Soulbind is a perfect set up for double Laguna Blade.

entries.name: Slark
lines: Pounce allows Slark to leash enemy heroes, making it easier for Lina to land Light Strike Array.
Depth Shroud from Aghanim's Shard allows Slark to hide himself and Lina from enemies, and to attack them freely without revealing themselves.
Heroes with stuns, roots or hides that can set up a Light Strike Array are a great addition to Lina: Luna, Jakiro, Shadow Demon, Naga Siren, Shadow Shaman, Outworld Destroyer, Treant Protector.
Heroes who can apply pressure on lane are good team with Lina: Axe, Venomancer, Viper, Huskar, Skywrath Mage, Dazzle, Necrophos, Batrider.
Heroes that can use their abilities to save or protect their teammates can be life-savers for Lina: Outworld Destroyer, Dawnbreaker, Naga Siren, Bane, Slark, Omniknight, Dazzle.

Heroes who lack strong disable or have no strong disable on their own (unless if they choose to build disabling items) or have difficulties landing them will benefit from Lina stunning fleeing enemy heroes with Light Strike Array: Razor, Viper, Clockwerk, Weaver, Ursa, Mirana, Leshrac, Blood finding, Hoodwink, Jakiro, Troll Warlord.

Heroes who want to push lanes will benefit from Lina's area-of-effect abilities: {H|Luna}}, Pugna, Jakiro, Keeper of the Light, Broodmother, Naga Siren, Shadow Shaman, Death Prophet, Lycan, Visage, Razor with Aghanim's Scepter, Venomancer, Meepo, Enigma, Holy Knight, Nature's Prophet, Warlock, Phantom Lancer, Terrorblade etc.
Gleipnir makes it much easier for Lina to land Light Strike Array on multiple enemy heroes at once.
Wind Waker can be a good setup for Light Strike Array when timed correctly.

entries.name: Tango
lines: Tango restores health to keep Lina in lane.

entries.name: Null Talisman
lines: Null Talisman gives attributes and mana regeneration.

entries.name: Clarity
lines: Clarity sustains mana so Lina can keep using abilities, threatening enemies more.

entries.name: Regular Stick
lines: Regular Stick is useful for absolutely no reason.

entries.name: Boots of Speed
lines: Boots of Speed helps Lina get into position to land her abilities while avoiding danger zones.

entries.name: Bottle
lines: Bottle is a common pickup for Lina when playing in the mid lane.

entries.name: Arcane Boots
lines: Arcane Boots is a must-have item for Lina no matter which role she is playing, as the mana replenish will allow Lina to use her abilities more often and restore her own and her allies's mana.

entries.name: Force Staff
lines: Force Staff gives Lina more intelligence, health and an escape tool for either escaping or chasing enemy heroes. Later it can be upgraded into Hurricane Pike that can also give her more attack range.

entries.name: Witch Blade
lines: Witch Blade gives Lina attack speed, armor, more intelligence, and increases the traveling speed of her attack projectiles while also providing Lina with true strike every 9 seconds.

entries.name: Eul's Scepter of Divinity
lines: Eul's Scepter of Divinity enhances Lina's positioning and greatly boosts mana regeneration. It can also be used to set up Light Strike Array more reliably.

entries.name: Aghanim's Scepter
lines: Aghanim's Scepter will give Lina access to Flame Cloak ability that will allow her to gain unobstructed movement, magical damage resitance and extra spell damage.

entries.name: Black King Bar
lines: Black King Bar will give Lina spell immunity, which will allow Lina to use her abilities and to attack enemy heroes with minimal risk of getting affected by enemy abilities, it will also increase her strength and attack damage.

entries.name: Hurricane Pike
lines: Hurricane Pike, an upgrade for Force Staff gives Lina extra mobility to use for either escaping or catching up with enemy heroes and the increased attack range that allows her to attack enemies from safer distances.

entries.name: Crystalys
lines: Crystalys provides a good damage boost when playing as a semi-carry Lina, and can be upgraded to Daedalus or Khanda.

entries.name: Parasma
lines: Parasma, an upgrade for Witch Blade will allow Lina's attacks to weaken magic resistance by 20% for 3 seconds, making them more vulnerable to her abilities that deal magical damage.

entries.name: Wind Waker
lines: Wind Waker, an upgrade for Eul's Scepter of Divinity gives Lina bonus mana regeneration along with an escape tool and much needed mobility.

entries.name: Aghanim's Shard
lines: Aghanim's Shard will allow Lina's Fiery Soul to have her all of her abilities to deal 20 more damage for each charge provided by Fiery Soul.

entries.name: Scythe of Vyse
lines: Scythe of Vyse will give Lina an important disable that also helps to ensure she lands Light Strike Array. Furthermore, its attribute bonuses will make her a bit more survivable and drastically improves her mana regeneration.

entries.name: Silver Edge
lines: Silver Edge can be useful for a carry Lina, as it helps her to cast Light Strike Array while invisible, and also provides her with an escape mechanism. It will also allow Lina's attacks to disable an enemy hero's passive abilities.

entries.name: Daedalus
lines: Daedalus is an upgrade for Crystalys to greatly improve a carry Lina's attack damage, complementing Fiery Soul's attack speed bonus.

entries.name: Veil of Discord
lines: Veil of Discord will give Lina armor, ince attributes and will also allow her to weaken the magic resistance of nearby enemy heroes, causing them to take amplified damage from Dragon Slave, Light Strike Array and Laguna Blade. Veil of Discord can later be upgraded into Shiva's Guard for bonus armor, attack speed reduction and heal reduction of nearby heroes.

entries.name: Monkey King Bar
lines: Monkey King Bar can be useful for a carry Lina, as it can give her bonus attack speed and attack damage, and the ability to have her attacks pierce evasion.

entries.name: Satanic
lines: Satanic increases Lina's survivability by providing her lifesteal, and allows carry Lina to use her high DPS to rapidly heal to full health.

entries.name: Shiva's Guard
lines: Shiva's Guard, an upgrade for Veil of Discord will greatly increase Lina's low armor while also allowing her to reduce the magic resistance, attack speed and heals of nearby enemy heroes.

entries.name: Linken's Sphere
lines: Linken's Sphere provide attributes to Lina's overall stats. The passive Spell Block also protects her from disables.

entries.name: Blink Dagger
lines: Blink Dagger gives Lina the ability to stay back in safety, then blink in at an opportune moment to cast her Light Strike Array before the enemy can see her coming and evade it.

entries.name: Bloodstone
lines: Bloodstone will give Lina very good amount of health and mana along with spell lifesteal that will allow Lina to heal herself whenever she damages enemies with her abilities.

entries.name: Dagon
lines: Dagon will give Lina nice attributes and even more magical damage burst along with spell lifesteal. Its active ability can be used to put Linken's Sphere on cooldown before using Laguna Blade.

entries.name: Ethereal Blade
lines: Ethereal Blade provides mana and mana regeneration for Lina's abilities, a greater cast range for all of her targeted abilities along with the ability to disarm enemy heroes and make them more vulnerable to her abilities that deal magical damage, or to protect herself from physical attackers.

entries.name: Revenant's Brooch
lines: Revenant's Brooch will give Lina great attack damage, spell lifesteal, and will also allow Lina's attacks to deal magical damage that can pierce through armor and to attack ethereal units at the cost of 50 mana while it's active.

entries.name: Rod of Atos
lines: Rod of Atos provides Lina with improved stats and a root to disable enemies that can make landing of Light Strike Array much easier. Rod of Atos can later be upgraded to Gleipnir with a Chain Lightning effect that procs reliably with Fiery Soul for heavy damage along with a root in an area.

entries.name: Gleipnir
lines: Gleipnir an upgrade for Rod of Atos will give Lina more health to withstand more damage, more intelligence to use her abilities more often, passive chain lightning that can make her attacks bounce between enemies and damage them, and an active root in a area that will allow Lina to root multiple enemies at once, making them easier targets for Light Strike Array.

entries.name: Abyssal Blade
lines: Abyssal Blade will increase Lina's durability and will also allow Lina's attacks to stun enemy heroes, and the bash will proc often thanks to Lina's high attack speed from Fiery Soul even if she is a ranged hero. Abyssal Blade will also allow Lina to stun an enemy hero if he/she gets too close to Lina even if they are debuff immune, making them easier targets for Light Strike Array.

pros: Deals fairly high physical damage with passive.
playstyle.text: Lina is a powerful ranged intelligence hero that can be played as a support or a semi-carry. Her abilities allow her to nuke and stun multiple heroes at once and her strong ultimate can annihilate low health heroes. Her passive allows her right-clicks to far exceed that of other typical intelligence heroes, giving her a very respectable amount of physical damage output. Played well, Lina is an extremely strong ganking hero who can kill out of position heroes all by herself.
cons: No mobility and durability without items.

lines: Semi-carry Linas typically take the mid lane and aim to bully the enemy mid with superior range right clicks and Dragon Slave spam whilst farming a fast Eul's Scepter. You should aim to push the wave in order to secure runes and when you have enough levels, begin roaming around the map, setting up kills with your allies.

With a Blink Dagger, you should aim to solo kill enemies with a Eul's into Light Strike Array combo along with your nukes and right clicks. You should use this time to shut down the enemy carries and acquire farm so that you and your team have a farm and gold advantage.

Depending on the enemy composition, you will want to build into late game items that enable you to kill enemies more effectively. Fiery Soul allows you the option of building right click enhancing items such as Desolator, Daedalus or Monkey King Bar, allowing you impressive damage output that can deal with heroes that can survive your magic burst or are natural Black King Bar carriers. Aghanim's Scepter allows your ult to deal Pure damage and go right through spell immunity, so consider this as a choice should you be up against enemies with Black King Bars.

However, builds that utilize powerful right click items generally won't provide you with much mana. Given Lina's low cooldown nukes and extremely high mana-cost Ultimate, you will find yourself running out of mana very quickly in prolonged engagements, something which a Eul's Scepter alone will not remedy. Consider items like Bloodstone, Octarine Core or Scythe of Vyse to keep you topped up on mana.

In the same vein, you should not neglect to build for defense/positioning, as you are very squishy at all stages of the game and can easily be ganged up on by multiple heroes, feeding away experience and hindering your ability to snowball. Items like Drum of Endurance, Force Staff and Black King Bar allow you to last longer in fights, ensuring you are able to dish out your damage or escape a losing battle.
Lina's passive allows her to scale extremely well into the late game with her constant high attack speed. Due to her out-ranging most heroes, she is similar to Sniper.

Support Linas consumes much less farming resources and can participate in roaming and ganking at an early time. She prefers Position 4 to support off-lane core, due to a constant harassment of the enemy's core with Light Strike Array and robbery of stacking creeps with Dragon Slave. She can take great advantage of enemy heroes during the laning phase.

Basically, support Linas give up the physical damages and concentrate on magical damages, survival and aids to your core heroes. Aether Lens and Aghanim's Scepter are good choices for damages, while Force Staff and Glimmer Cape are always useful at critical moments.
Grants bonus attack damage.
The health talent increases the max health capacity and keeps the current health percentage.
Lina has one of the longest attack ranges in the game, but also the slowest attack animation. Time your attacks well to get last hits.
Always cancel the backswing animation after casting your spells, as Lina suffers from long animation times.
In teamfights it can be very beneficial to quickly focus on low-HP or support heroes, as Lina has very good nuking abilities.

If Lina has the basic items she needs, it is wise to augment her physical attack for the sake of Fiery Soul. Almost uniquely among intelligence supports, Lina's attacks becomes a serious threat if she attains a level advantage (owing to her enormous intelligence growth and her passive ability).
Use Dragon Slave to harass and get last hits in lane.
Dragon Slave's range is deceptively long, and can be used to finish off fleeing opponents, or as a parting shot when retreating.
Max Dragon Slave first if your intent is to deal the most damage possible.
Use Dragon Slave to stack without really leaving the exp from the lane.
More tips needed.
Light Strike Array is often leveled first because the stun can either save Lina or help her finish a gank.
Combining Light Strike Array with a guaranteed stun such as Magic Missile or Storm Hammer makes Lina a serious ganking force early on.
Light Strike Array has a very long cast animation. Make sure to target near Lina, so she doesn't need to move into range before casting it.
Positioning items such as Eul's Scepter of Divinity, Blink Dagger, or Force Staff can help land Light Strike Array and thus Lina's whole spell combo without relying on other heroes.
Use Light Strike Array to destroy trees around enemy towers, spotting defenders.
More tips needed.
One early point in Fiery Soul can boost Lina's harass potential, especially after landing Light Strike Array on an enemy, as her attack speed will be temporarily increased.
Use all of Lina's other abilities first to take the speed-enhancing effect of Fiery Soul to its maximum potential.
It is sometimes acceptable to use Lina's other abilities simply to gain Fiery Soul's speed bonuses, such as when attacking a tower, or when you're certain no enemies are nearby.
In a prolonged teamfight, remember to continuously use Lina's abilities the moment they come off cooldown, so her attack speed remains high throughout the fight.
More tips needed.

Upon reaching level six, immediately begin looking for opportunities to use Laguna Blade, as few enemies can withstand its massive damage in the early game. A few kills with Laguna Blade in the early game can put Lina's team comfortably ahead.
In most cases, it is better to deal the burst damage right away in teamfights instead of saving Laguna Blade until the very last moment to finish an enemy.
Only save Laguna Blade for situations where ending an enemy decisively would prevent them from recovering, such as against targets with high health regeneration.
Do not waste Laguna Blade on a target that is certain to die.
Laguna Blade can hit for 1800 pure damage if she combines Aghanim's Scepter and Refresher Orb, granting her enormous nuking power.
Since Laguna Blade is blocked by Spell Block, it would be wise to invest for a single-targeted item such as a Eul's Scepter of Divinity.

Талант 25 уровня: «Атаки наносят 150% крит. урона жертвам заклинаний» заменено на «Атаки наносят 150% крит. урона жертвам Slow Burn»
Талант 25 уровня: «+60% к урону от перегрева у Combustion» заменено на «+1 сек. действия Slow Burn»

bio: Соперничество огненной волшебницы и её младшей ледяной сестрицы стали поистину легендарными в тех тихих местах, где девочки провели своё буйное детство. И всё же старшая сестра всегда одерживала верх, ведь её горячность и пыл уравновешивались смекалкой и коварством, а вот младшая сестра была проста и наивна. Отчаявшиеся родители несовместимых отпрысков меняли дома один за другим, теряя их то в огне, то во льду. В конце концов они поняли: жить станет проще, если разлучить сестёр. Старшую отправили далеко на юг, к терпеливой тётушке в знойную пустыню Мизрула, погода которой пришлась любительнице огня по душе. Новая соседка тут же всполошила неторопливый местный народ и опалила пальцы и брови далеко не одного горе-ухажёра. Она горда и уверена в себе, и ничто не затушит её пламя.
trivia: Прототипом Лины является одноимённый персонаж аниме-сериалов, фильмов, манги, игр и книг из серии Slayers. В Dota 2 были также сохранены названия способностей персонажа, такие как Dragon Slave, Light Strike Array и Laguna Blade (в оригинале Ragna Blade).
Lina — первый созданный герой в Dota 2.
Фраза при атаке "Helter swelter!" — отсылка к песне группы The Beatles — Helter Skelter.
Фраза Лины "Лучше сгореть, чем угаснуть" взята из предсмертной записки Курта Кобейна.

notes.text: Пламя распространяется со скоростью 1200, достигая максимальной дальности спустя 0,9 сек.
Задевает существ на расстоянии до 1275 единиц (расстояние складывается из дальности прохождения и конечного радиуса).
Область поражения имеет форму конуса.
Dragon Slave сначала наносит урон, затем накладывает дебафф.
Накладывает на врагов дебафф, который наносит урон с интервалом в 1 секунду, начиная через 1 секунду после применения способности. Действует 3 сек.
Суммарно наносит до 105/210/315/420 урона (до учёта сопротивлений).
Последовательное применение способности не увеличивает урон от дебаффа, но обновляет его длительность.
Наносит следующее количество урона (до учёта сопротивлений):
Во время действия Flame Cloak наносит до 141,75/283,5/425,25/567 урона.
С максимальным количеством эффектов Fiery Soul наносит до 245/350/455/560 урона.
Бонус к урону от способности за эффект не влияет на периодический урон.
С активной Flame Cloak и максимальным количеством эффектов Fiery Soul наносит до 330,75/472,5/614,25/756 урона.

notes: Задевает существ на расстоянии до 1225 единиц.
Эту способность нельзя заблокировать или отразить.
abilities.lore: Борясь со скукой в выжженных пустошах Мизрула, волшебница научилась управлять пламенем пустынного дракона.
abilities.description: Герой высвобождает дыхание дракона, сжигающее всех врагов на своём пути.
abilities.name: Dragon Slave

notes.text: Light Strike Array сначала применяет оглушение, затем наносит урон.
Light Strike Array уничтожает деревья в затронутой области.
Визуальный эффект и звук во время задержки длительностью 0,5 сек. видны и слышны только союзникам.
У Lina есть две разные анимации для этой способности, поэтому длительность остаточной анимации варьируется.
Наносит следующее количество урона (до учёта сопротивлений):
Во время действия Flame Cloak наносит до 148,5/216/283,5/351 (351/418,5/486/553,5) урона.
С максимальным количеством эффектов Fiery Soul наносит до 250/300/350/400 (400/450/500/550) урона.
С активной Flame Cloak и максимальным количеством эффектов Fiery Soul наносит до 337,5/405/472,5/540 (540/607,5/675/742,5) урона.

notes: Уничтожает деревья в зоне действия способности.
abilities.lore: Сущность волшебницы позволяет ей управлять энергией солнца, воспламеняя воздух взмахом рук.
abilities.description: Призывает столб пламени, который оглушает врагов и наносит им урон.
abilities.name: Light Strike Array

notes.text: Даёт эффект каждый раз, когда одна из способностей Lina наносит урон противникам (до учёта сопротивлений), включая постройки, если способность может нанести им урон (например, если будет отражена Toss).
Не срабатывает при использовании предметов, способностей без перезарядки или способностей, которые не провоцируют срабатывание от применения.
Эффекты имеют общую длительность. Получение нового эффекта обновляет длительность всех эффектов.
Ниже перечислены значения бонусов к скорости передвижения и скорости атаки, которые даёт Fiery Soul, вплоть до 7 стаков на каждом уровне:
2 стака:
2%/3%/4%/5% (4%/5%/6%/7%) к скорости передвижения.
3 стака:
4 стака:
4%/6%/8%/10% (8%/10%/12%/14%) к скорости передвижения.
5 стаков:
6 стаков:
6%/9%/12%/15% (12%/15%/18%/21%) к скорости передвижения.
7 стаков:
Также даёт дополнительный урон от способностей, равный 20/40/60/80/100/120/140, с каждым количеством стаков.

notes: Попадание любой способности по врагу обновляет время действия этой.
abilities.lore: Пляшущие языки огня воплощают игривую натуру волшебницы, высвобождая её внутреннее пламя.
abilities.description: Увеличивает скорость атаки и передвижения всякий раз, когда герой попадает способностью по врагу. Эффекты способности складываются друг с другом. Действует 16 сек.
abilities.name: Fiery Soul

notes.text: Требуется Aghanim's Scepter для разблокировки.
Прерывает произносимые способности Lina при применении.
Дарует следующие бонусы при активации:
Устанавливает число эффектов Fiery Soul, равное 7, при применении.

Обладает таким же приоритетом по установке максимального количества эффектов, что и Laguna Blade. Применение Laguna Blade после Flame Cloak заменяет установленное значение максимального количества эффектов на текущее, и наоборот.
Сочетается по закону убывающей полезности с другими источниками сопротивления магии.
Увеличивает общее сопротивление магии Lina до 51,25%.
Каждые 10 очков интеллекта в произведении с этим источником увеличивают общее сопротивление магии Lina на 0,65%. [?].
Превращает Lina в летающее существо, позволяя ей летать над непроходимой местностью, деревьями, существами и постройками на время действия способности.
Однако не дает герою беспрепятственный обзор.
Lina может использовать любые предметы и способности во время полёта.
Накладывает общее усиление исходящего урона на Lina. Сочетается аддитивно с другими общими усилениями исходящего урона.
Работает только на урон от заклинаний, источником которых является Lina. Не применяется к урону, который отмечен как отнимающий здоровье
При применении Lina поднимается на 100 единиц вверх по оси z.
Скорость полета равна текущей скорости передвижения героя.
Не превращает Rubick в летающее существо, хотя герой поднимается вверх. Продолжает давать беспрепятственное передвижение.
Не превращает Morphling в летающее существо. Герой не поднимается вверх. Продолжает давать беспрепятственное передвижение.

abilities.lore: Врождённая защита от настырных сестёр и зубастых тварей.
abilities.description: Дарует герою беспрепятственное передвижение. Увеличивает его урон от заклинаний и сопротивление магии. Применение даёт владельцу максимум эффектов способности Fiery Soul.
abilities.name: Flame Cloak

abilities.description: Способности героя дополнительно наносят 64% урона горением в течение 4 сек.
abilities.name: Slow Burn

notes.text: Применяет к цели дебафф, наносящий урон при его завершении. Дебафф длится 0,25 сек.
То есть способность можно избежать с помощью неуязвимости или исчезновения, пока дебафф не нанёс урон.
При применении Laguna Blade сначала устанавливает максимальное число эффектов Fiery Soul, равное 10, а затем устанавливает такое же число эффектов на время длительности озарения.
По завершении озарения число эффектов уменьшается до 7.

Обладает таким же приоритетом по установке максимального количества эффектов, что и Flame Cloak. Применение Laguna Blade после Flame Cloak заменяет установленное значение максимального количества эффектов на текущее, и наоборот.
Laguna Blade сначала наносит урон, затем дарует эффекты.
Таким образом, улучшение от Aghanim's Shard не влияет на исходящий урон.
Наносит следующее количество урона (до учёта сопротивлений):
Во время действия Flame Cloak наносит до 675/945/1215 урона.
С максимальным количеством эффектов Fiery Soul наносит до 640/840/1040 урона.
С активной Flame Cloak и максимальным количеством эффектов Fiery Soul наносит до 864/1134/1404 урона.
Меняет урон от Laguna Blade на чистый и делает возможным применение этой способности на курьеров.

notes: Между применением способности и нанесением урона есть задержка в 0.25 сек., что даёт возможность избежать урона.
abilities.lore: Воздух вокруг волшебницы становится таким горячим, что он обжигает молнией любого врага, подошедшего слишком близко.
abilities.description: Выпускает разряд молнии в одного врага, нанося сокрушительный урон.
abilities.name: Laguna Blade
abilities.shard: Применение Laguna Blade озаряет владельца, отчего тот получает эффекты способности Fiery Soul.

hype: Опасная и хрупкая Lina легко свалит любого одинокого врага. Она поражает противников огнём и молнией, а каждое произнесённое ей заклинание увеличивает скорость её атаки, не давая выжить никому.
name: Lina
short: Атакует и передвигается быстрее с каждой применённой способностью

talents.left: +110 к урону от Light Strike Array
talents.right: Fiery Soul даёт +5% к сопр. магии за эффект

talents.left: Атаки наносят 150% крит. урона жертвам Slow Burn
